result.response:
The issue described in [`requirement.feature`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/time_14_group_d_fix/requirement.feature) occurs when adding or subtracting months or days to/from a partial instance where month-of-year is the largest field (such as [`MonthDay`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/time_14_group_d_fix/src/main/java/org/joda/time/MonthDay.java)) starting on February 29th or near month boundaries. In [`BasicMonthOfYearDateTimeField.add(ReadablePartial, int, int[], int)`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/time_14_group_d_fix/src/main/java/org/joda/time/chrono/BasicMonthOfYearDateTimeField.java#L203), when `partial` was contiguous, an instant was constructed starting at `0L` (1970-01-01, a non-leap year). Setting day 29 for February 1970 caused an `IllegalFieldValueException`.

### Fix
In [`BasicMonthOfYearDateTimeField.java`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/time_14_group_d_fix/src/main/java/org/joda/time/chrono/BasicMonthOfYearDateTimeField.java#L206-L215), when `monthOfYear` is the largest field and is the target of the addition (`fieldIndex == 0`), calculate the new month directly using modular arithmetic and update the partial values via `set(...)`, which automatically handles adjusting smaller fields (such as `dayOfMonth`).

### Verification & Patch
- All 8 scenarios in [`requirement.feature`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/time_14_group_d_fix/requirement.feature) passed with 0 failures and 0 errors.
- The focused patch has been saved to [`enlightened_fix.patch`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/time_14_group_d_fix/enlightened_fix.patch).
